READ-ONLY SCOPE FINDING on bd-01M1789P5B9WVNCJFN3HXACWKN; no claim or edit.

The current recommendation to drop Option because the SourceView law guarantees a meaningful relativePosition is incomplete. The law proves node totality, but Laws.scala positionsAreMeasured returns true whenever textLength <= 0. SourceView.relativeSpan returns None at textLength 0 and relativePosition converts that to the meaningful value 0.0. InMemorySourceView is still a public case class with an unchecked Int textLength, so an external caller can construct nonempty nodes with textLength 0. Repository occurrence remains measured negative; public admission remains positive.

Therefore do not mechanically make discoursePos total yet. The bead needs one explicit disposition:
A. close the InMemorySourceView construction boundary so exposed nodes require positive textLength, strengthen positionsAreMeasured to require a real span, then use a total discourse comparator while retaining a partial world comparator; or
B. retain relativeSpan absence through discourse chronology so a zero-length view abstains.

The behavior-preserving internal refactor should separate total discourse ordering from partial world ordering rather than using one SourceNodeRef-to-Option-Double type for both. Add a zero-length/nonempty-node court that discriminates A from B, plus no-churn chronology assertions on current lawful views.

Adjacent stale documentation: source.scala and Laws.scala still say both implementations state the invariant in neither place, even though SourceView now states it. Correct that in whichever candidate owns the remainder.

This does not promote the bead above P2: permits yes, in-repo occurs no, consumes yes.
